comment: What people actually ask the shader assistant for. Each description is sent verbatim as the user's request; every generated shader is compiled in both dialects by check.mjs, and judged by eye at the three shapes below - a roofline that is one pixel tall, a tall thin mega-tree, and a square matrix. Results live in results/ next to this file, one JSON per run, so a prompt change can be compared against the last run rather than against memory.

descriptions.text: a smooth wash that fades between my colours
a chase that runs along the roofline
everything pulsing to a steady beat
a spinning tunnel you fly into
alternating flashes between my first two colours
green streaks falling like digital rain
a comet circling with a long tail
random sparkles over a solid colour
a two colour checkerboard sliding sideways
a sunrise slowly rising from the bottom
